enhanced_name_5w: Prefab Steel Shed and Building Systems
enhanced_name_6w: PEB Prefab Sheds Warehouses and Industrial Buildings
enhanced_name_long: Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings, Prefabricated Industrial Sheds, Warehouses, Portable Cabins and Modular Structures for Factory, Commercial and Institutional Use
segment_contamination_dimensions: Agricultural/horticultural buyers seeking greenhouse, polyhouse, or mist chamber structures — these buyers are farmers and agri-operators with fundamentally different use contexts and price tiers from industrial/commercial prefab buyers; terms such as greenhouse, polyhouse, naturally ventilated, agricultural building, and mist chamber are blocked.

Tensile/membrane structure buyers seeking fabric-based canopy or shade structures (tensile structures, tensile membrane, modular tensile, gazebo tensile, auditorium tensile) — these buyers seek fabric-and-frame canopy solutions, not steel-panel prefab buildings; tensile-specific terms are blocked.

Specialist institutional sub-segment buyers where a dedicated sibling MCAT already carves out that segment — terms that would exclusively attract buyers of prefabricated school buildings, prefabricated hospitals, prefabricated isolation wards, or prefabricated labour colonies as standalone product searches are blocked to avoid collision with those sibling MCATs.

Aluminium structure buyers and heavy structural fabrication buyers — these attract buyers seeking aluminium-frame or heavy-steel fabrication services rather than complete prefab building systems; aluminium structure and heavy structural fabrication terms are blocked.
